text: A solid black rectangle (approx x370-910, y45-96) sits at top-centre over the HUD, clipping the NEXT objective text ('Screen room's l...'). Seen right after Continue in the vestibule, facing south down the List corridor.

After winning round 2 of the List: the right-hand annotations say 'differs at tile 1 / 2 / 1 / 4 / 1 / 2 / 1 / 3' and red boxes mark each row's FIRST mismatch, while the gold diagonal and the caption under the board say 'row n differs at tile n'. Two different explanations of why the row is new are drawn at once; the numbers next to rows 3-8 contradict the diagonal story the caption tells.

Reached the Prover room via the List's right-hand door. On the way, walking from the answer lectern toward the Prover door I slid along and got wedged against the left-hand bookshelf beside the door (x=-15.25 z=34.2), and pt walkto door timed out there; had to back up and re-aim. The bookshelves flanking the door make the opening narrow.
